result.title: Geophysics-informed invertible operator network for Bayesian geophysical inversion
result.summary: Geophysical inverse problems are inherently ill-posed because of sparse observations and measurement noise. Classical sampling-based Bayesian inference methods, such as Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), are computationally prohibitive because they require many forward simulations. Data-driven machine-learning methods often struggle to produce physically consistent solutions when training data are limited. To address these issues, we propose a geophysics-informed invertible operator network (GI-ION) that integrates an invertible neural network (INN) within a deep operator-learning framework for efficient Bayesian geophysical inversion. The INN serves as the branch network and transforms the model parameters into branch coefficients that represent the forward solution and a latent variable that captures uncertainty in the inverse problem. By learning the forward operator and enforcing statistical independence between the branch coefficients and the latent variable, GI-ION enables efficient sampling from a learned conditional approximation, even with sparse boundary observations. We validated GI-ION on three representative cases: 1D surface-wave dispersion and travel-time tomography for a 2D synthetic random-field model and a seismic-slice model. Numerical experiments demonstrate robust performance across diverse problem settings and efficient conditional sampling.

AI.brief_summary: 提出地球物理信息引导的可逆算子网络 GI-ION，把 INN 作为 branch 网络嵌入深度算子学习框架，在学得前向算子的同时用隐变量刻画反演不确定性，并借统计独立性约束在稀疏边界观测下实现高效条件采样。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用可逆映射把分支系数与不确定性隐变量分离、并以独立性约束支持的潜在空间采样，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态与内容／不确定性的解耦及多种 latent 假设有关，可供核查；但属地球物理反演，与视觉推理联系较远。
